hook.line: To get paid a lot in marketing you don't need a degree or experience.
hook.visual: Arm's-length walking selfie on a busy city street, then a smiling shot holding an iced drink, with the title 'how to break into marketing without experience' and a '21 y/o in tech, 6-figures' subline.

beats.what: Aspirational city-walk vlog shots under the title and credibility subline while she states the no-degree claim.
Cut to a seated talking head holding a small mic; she sets up her own credentials (finance student, six-figure job).
Step 1 title at top: make content even without followers, using products you already own.
Top text restates the lesson: making videos teaches marketing better than a classroom.
Cut to her laptop showing her Canva portfolio site with punch-in zooms and 'u can build for free on canva.com'.
Quick shots of a second site page (a team grid) as she says to fill it with videos and brand concepts.
Back to her face: the website got her six figures; Step 3 cold outreach to marketing teams on LinkedIn.
Payoff text: once you master video storytelling you can be the one managing campaigns and creators.
'follow for part 2' title closes the video.

why_it_works: Lifestyle b-roll (city walk, iced drink) plus a '21 y/o, 6-figures' subline shows the result before the method, so viewers stay to learn how.
Numbered step titles at the top of the frame let a muted viewer follow the three-step structure.
Her real portfolio site on a laptop, with punch-in zooms (2.37 per min), proves step 2 instead of just describing it.
Dense, near-silence-free delivery (3.89 words/s, 2.8% silence) with jump cuts every 2.47 s median keeps pace high.
weaknesses: A 32.3 s single shot in the second half; the step-3 outreach is spoken with no visual (no LinkedIn screen).
Single-word captions are tiny (caption height median 0.034) and compete with the top step titles.
Very loud mix (-9.7 LUFS) with no music bed.
for_robert: Open on a few seconds of the result (your life or outcome) under a title that names the promise and your credential, before cutting to the talking head; Fred could hold a numbered step sign at the top for each step.
